name: Koala Bundles
summary: Shopify app (by ProfitKoala) for quantity breaks, multi-product bundles, cart volume discounts, BOGO offers and one-click post-purchase upsells, with an announcement bar and countdown timer; every plan has the same features and is metered on the bundle revenue the offers bring in.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want quantity breaks, multi-product bundles, cart volume discounts, BOGO offers and one-click post-purchase upsells in one app, with every feature on every plan and a price that stays small while bundle sales are small
skip_if: you need each bundle variant tied to its own SKU for a supplier or 3PL, because reviewers say Koala applies a discount rather than tracking bundle inventory; or your bundle sales swing well past $5,000 in a peak month and you cannot watch the cap, because the offers pause 24 hours after you reach it
honest_knock:
The meter is revenue, and it counts more of it than you might expect. The help centre defines bundle offer revenue as the whole value of the bundle a customer buys through a Koala offer, not the uplift over the normal price: a $70 three-pack adds $70 to the counter even if one unit on its own would have sold for $30. Kickstart's $1,000 a month is therefore roughly fourteen of those $70 bundles, and a store selling a few bundles a day is past it in the first week. Scale Koala's $5,000 is the realistic starting point for a store that actually uses bundles as a main offer, and above that the next step is Unlimited at $59.99, three times the price.

What happens at the ceiling matters more than the price. There is no overage charge; instead the store owner gets an email at 80% and at 100%, and if nobody upgrades within 24 hours the offers are paused until the first of the next month. A 24-hour window is short: a cap reached on a Friday night during a promotion can take the bundles off the product pages before anyone reads the email. If bundles are part of a campaign, set the plan on the revenue you expect at the peak, and check the usage counter in the app while it runs.

The counter is only as good as the attribution behind it. On 29 September 2026 a US merchant with four months on the app wrote that Koala counted an order as a bundle sale when the customer bought one unit of a buy-three offer plus other items and never received the discount. We could not check that claim, but it is worth testing on your own store, because on this pricing model an overcount is not just a flattering report: it moves you towards the cap. Other critical reviews describe a bundle that could not map each variant to its own SKU for the supplier (July 2025), products shown as sold out despite stock (December 2025), and a widget that loaded slowly; the help centre says a delay of four to five seconds goes away once you add the app block to the product template instead of relying on the embed. We have not installed the app.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Kickstart · per month for up to $1,000 of bundle offer revenue, or $131.88 a year
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-11-26 on apps.shopify.com/profitkoala-upsell-bundle: every plan name and amount unchanged; first read 2026-09-30 on apps.shopify.com/profitkoala-upsell-bundle and in the vendor's billing articles at koala-bundles.crisp.help) Priced on the revenue its offers bring in, not on features: the help centre says all plans include the same features. Kickstart is $12.99 a month, or $131.88 a year at a stated 15% saving, for up to $1,000 of bundle offer revenue a month, and the listing marks it with a discounted price for first-time users. Scale Koala is $19.99 a month or $191.88 a year for up to $5,000. Unlimited is $59.99 a month or $575.88 a year with no revenue ceiling. Every paid plan has a 14-day free trial. The listing also shows a free tier, described as 'perfect for development stores'; the billing article lists only the three paid plans for a live store. Bundle offer revenue is the full value of a bundle bought through a Koala block or post-purchase offer, not the extra amount it earned: a $70 three-pack counts as $70. At 80% of the cap the store owner gets a warning email, at 100% a second email, and if nothing changes within 24 hours the offers are paused until the first day of the next month. All charges are in USD, billed through Shopify every 30 days. Developer ProfitKoala, with an address in Vilnius, Lithuania; the listing gives a launch date of 11 March 2024 and shows 811 reviews.

compare_with.name: Easy Bundles
compare_with.why: Easy Bundles is the closest comparison in our own dossiers, because it is metered the same way: on bundle sales rather than on features or orders. On our reading of 4 September 2026 it was free up to $500 of bundle sales a month, $29 up to $3,000, $49 up to $5,000 and $99 up to $10,000, with no published tier above that. Koala Bundles, read on 30 September 2026, starts at $12.99 for $1,000, charges $19.99 up to $5,000 and $59.99 with no ceiling at all, so at every published level it is the cheaper of the two. The difference is what you get for the money. Easy Bundles builds real bundle products, with build-your-own-box, gift boxes, inventory synced across Shopify and 3PLs and POS support, and adds features plan by plan; Koala puts the same discount toolkit on every plan and is built around quantity breaks, volume discounts and post-purchase upsells. A store that ships bundles as their own SKUs fits Easy Bundles; a store that wants discount offers on existing products for less fits Koala.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Koala Bundles, called Upsell Koala Bundles in the admin, on a Shopify development store: the install, the plan wall before any use, the Kickstart test charge (approved in a second round, billed 0 dollars, still active), one quantity break offer, the Not visible status, the cancel route and the uninstall dialog. Nothing else was paid, cancelled, uninstalled or changed in the theme. Round 1, install and plan wall: the App Store listing (English) says Free to install. Free trial available., plan Free to install, Perfect for development stores, rating 4.9 from 830 reviews, developer ProfitKoala. Install was clicked at 10:39:30 and the install dialog (Install app, the app is called Upsell Koala Bundles in the admin) asked for access to customer data (device and activity data), staff data (store owner) and store data (products, orders, discounts, Online Store, Shopify admin); Install again at about 10:39:50. The Billing screen Choose your plan appeared at 10:40:05, about 35 seconds after the first click, with no onboarding or setup before the plan choice. The Offers page and every other page sent us back to Choose your plan, and there is no free plan on the screen, so nothing could be built. The FAQ Can I use the app for free? says the trial starts automatically when one of the paid plans is selected and that development stores can use the app at no cost, so the free route for a development store runs through choosing a paid plan and a test charge. The first Start 14-day trial at Kickstart Koala opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen with the test charge notice, $12,99 USD every 30 days and a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec; it was not approved and Cancel gave Charge declined., after which the app stayed installed without a plan. That round ended with the first core action not done. Round 2, test charge approved (a later decision on our side to continue; no payment method was added): Start 14-day trial at Kickstart Koala at about 10:51 opened the same screen (Subtotal $12,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total $12,99 due 1 Dec, an Approve button and an optional Add payment method row). Approve was active without a payment method, and we clicked Approve. The app said Plan activated successfully!, and in Shopify Settings, Billing the running total was $0,00 USD, billed on 17 Nov 2026, with no past bills. The app home shows Trial ends at Dec 1, 2026 and a Setup guide at 0 / 3: Activate the app embed, Create your first offer and Confirm the offer works. Core action: Create offer at 10:53:55 and Deal created successfully! at about 10:56, a bit over 2 minutes with page loads. Steps: Create offer, the offer type Quantity Breaks & Free Gift, Select, the first template (black), Select, Save, so 4 clicks and no field filled in; from the plan choice 6 clicks and about 5 minutes. The defaults were Applies to: All products, the title BUNDLE & SAVE and the tiers Buy One, Buy Two (save 10%) and Buy Three (save 20%), with an example price of $949.95. The Select offer screen lists Product page (7 types, among them Quantity Breaks & Free Gift, Product Bundle and Volume Discount), Post-purchase (1) and Boosters (2). Visibility: right after saving the offer had the status Not visible, with the warning Upsell Koala Bundles app isn't activated on your theme settings and the text that product page offers will not be visible until the app is activated in the theme settings, a modal Your offer won't be visible, and, on the same screen, a card saying Great job - your offer is live! with the buttons Looks awesome!, Something's off... and Preview offer. The app embed in the theme was not switched on, because that is a theme change, so the widget was not seen on a product page; the offer was only seen in the app preview (Buy One $949.95, Buy Two with You save 10%). The card and the status contradict each other. Cancelling: the Billing screen shows Kickstart Koala as Selected and the Current plan, billed every month at $12.99, trial ends at Dec 1, 2026, with no cancel button; Shopify Settings, Billing and the Current billing cycle show only $0,00 USD and Add payment method, and no cancel button for app plans. The FAQ What if I want to change or cancel my plan? says: cancel without any charges during the 14-day trial, downgrades are prorated but cancellations are not, and Contact support to explore refund options. A plan cannot be stopped inside the app; the only routes seen are contacting support or uninstalling the app. The Uninstall dialog (Settings, Apps, the menu next to the app with Open app, View details, Get support and Uninstall) says that after uninstalling any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted and that a request goes to the developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information; it was cancelled and nothing was removed. The plan was therefore not cancelled: the Kickstart test charge stays active with the trial until 1 Dec and $0 billed, and one quantity break offer for All products stays in the app. Not tested: a volume discount or a product bundle, the widget on a product page and a theme preview, the Offers and Analytics pages beyond the list, what happens after the trial ends, support or live chat, post-purchase upsell, bundles as their own SKU and the best seller audience. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app does not open without a paid plan, there is no cancel button for the plan, and the offer said it was live while its status was Not visible.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Koala Bundles, called Upsell Koala Bundles in the admin, on a Shopify development store: the install, the plan wall before any use, the Kickstart test charge (approved in a second round, billed 0 dollars, still active), one quantity break offer, the Not visible status, the cancel route and the uninstall dialog. Nothing else was paid, cancelled, uninstalled or changed in the theme. Round 1, install and plan wall: the App Store listing (English) says Free to install. Free trial available., plan Free to install, Perfect for development stores, rating 4.9 from 830 reviews, developer ProfitKoala. Install was clicked at 10:39:30 and the install dialog (Install app, the app is called Upsell Koala Bundles in the admin) asked for access to customer data (device and activity data), staff data (store owner) and store data (products, orders, discounts, Online Store, Shopify admin); Install again at about 10:39:50. The Billing screen Choose your plan appeared at 10:40:05, about 35 seconds after the first click, with no onboarding or setup before the plan choice. The Offers page and every other page sent us back to Choose your plan, and there is no free plan on the screen, so nothing could be built. The FAQ Can I use the app for free? says the trial starts automatically when one of the paid plans is selected and that development stores can use the app at no cost, so the free route for a development store runs through choosing a paid plan and a test charge. The first Start 14-day trial at Kickstart Koala opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen with the test charge notice, $12,99 USD every 30 days and a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec; it was not approved and Cancel gave Charge declined., after which the app stayed installed without a plan. That round ended with the first core action not done. Round 2, test charge approved (a later decision on our side to continue; no payment method was added): Start 14-day trial at Kickstart Koala at about 10:51 opened the same screen (Subtotal $12,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total $12,99 due 1 Dec, an Approve button and an optional Add payment method row). Approve was active without a payment method, and we clicked Approve. The app said Plan activated successfully!, and in Shopify Settings, Billing the running total was $0,00 USD, billed on 17 Nov 2026, with no past bills. The app home shows Trial ends at Dec 1, 2026 and a Setup guide at 0 / 3: Activate the app embed, Create your first offer and Confirm the offer works. Core action: Create offer at 10:53:55 and Deal created successfully! at about 10:56, a bit over 2 minutes with page loads. Steps: Create offer, the offer type Quantity Breaks & Free Gift, Select, the first template (black), Select, Save, so 4 clicks and no field filled in; from the plan choice 6 clicks and about 5 minutes. The defaults were Applies to: All products, the title BUNDLE & SAVE and the tiers Buy One, Buy Two (save 10%) and Buy Three (save 20%), with an example price of $949.95. The Select offer screen lists Product page (7 types, among them Quantity Breaks & Free Gift, Product Bundle and Volume Discount), Post-purchase (1) and Boosters (2). Visibility: right after saving the offer had the status Not visible, with the warning Upsell Koala Bundles app isn't activated on your theme settings and the text that product page offers will not be visible until the app is activated in the theme settings, a modal Your offer won't be visible, and, on the same screen, a card saying Great job - your offer is live! with the buttons Looks awesome!, Something's off... and Preview offer. The app embed in the theme was not switched on, because that is a theme change, so the widget was not seen on a product page; the offer was only seen in the app preview (Buy One $949.95, Buy Two with You save 10%). The card and the status contradict each other. Cancelling: the Billing screen shows Kickstart Koala as Selected and the Current plan, billed every month at $12.99, trial ends at Dec 1, 2026, with no cancel button; Shopify Settings, Billing and the Current billing cycle show only $0,00 USD and Add payment method, and no cancel button for app plans. The FAQ What if I want to change or cancel my plan? says: cancel without any charges during the 14-day trial, downgrades are prorated but cancellations are not, and Contact support to explore refund options. A plan cannot be stopped inside the app; the only routes seen are contacting support or uninstalling the app. The Uninstall dialog (Settings, Apps, the menu next to the app with Open app, View details, Get support and Uninstall) says that after uninstalling any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted and that a request goes to the developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information; it was cancelled and nothing was removed. The plan was therefore not cancelled: the Kickstart test charge stays active with the trial until 1 Dec and $0 billed, and one quantity break offer for All products stays in the app. Not tested: a volume discount or a product bundle, the widget on a product page and a theme preview, the Offers and Analytics pages beyond the list, what happens after the trial ends, support or live chat, post-purchase upsell, bundles as their own SKU and the best seller audience. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app does not open without a paid plan, there is no cancel button for the plan, and the offer said it was live while its status was Not visible.
